name: advance_counter_and_dispatch
description: Increments the shared counter and calls a routine with a table entry address scaled by four bytes per index, so each call selects one record from the table.

name: store_table_entry_byte
description: Copies one byte from a source record at offset two into a table slot chosen by the index register, using a four-byte stride between slots.

name: find_table_entry_index
description: Scans a table of four-byte entries and compares each entry's first two bytes with a stored pair of bytes, returning the matching index or minus one when none matches.

name: scan_pointer_pair_match
description: Steps through four-byte entries from a start pointer, comparing two bytes with a reference pair, and returns the step count of the first match or minus one when the table count is reached.

name: scan_offset_pair_match
description: Advances through four-byte entries in a do-while loop, matching the current entry's first byte and the next byte against reference bytes, and returns the index or minus one at the table end.

name: clear_nine_state_blocks
description: Calls a shared three-argument routine nine times with consecutive state addresses, a zero value and a count of thirty for the first eight blocks and ten for the last.

name: lookup_low_five_bits
description: Reads a byte from a table at an offset given by the shared index and returns only its low five bits.

name: follow_two_step_index_chain
description: Replaces the shared index with the byte stored at that index in a table, then replaces it again with the low five bits of a second lookup and returns the result.

name: emit_paired_updates_below_limit
description: When the shared counter is below ten, calls a routine twice with a value taken from a source byte incremented by one and a flag of one.

name: advance_phase_counter_lookup
description: Increments a shared phase counter and, once it passes two, resets it, adds sixty-four to a second byte, and reloads that byte from a four-byte-stride table indexed by its previous value.

name: step_four_byte_table_chain
description: Clears the shared index and, when it is non-zero, calls a routine and steps the index through several stride-four table lookups, using a second lookup path when the index is zero.

name: step_index_through_table_a
description: Steps the shared index through a stride-four table at a base offset, reading two entries when the index is non-zero and otherwise following a second table path.

name: step_index_through_table_b
description: Applies two successive stride-four table reads at an alternate offset to the shared index when it is non-zero.

name: reset_shared_index
description: Sets the shared index to zero, written as four identical assignments in the decompiled output.

name: run_nested_call_sequence
description: Runs three outer passes of ten-iteration inner loops that each call a shared routine twice, followed by a final ten-call loop and a restore of the saved index.

name: run_pointer_driven_call_loops
description: Repeats a nested loop of ten iterations per pass, writing computed values through three pointer arguments and calling a shared routine, then runs a final ten-iteration call loop.

name: invoke_nine_routine_sequence
description: Invokes a fixed sequence of nine shared routines in order, passing a constant zero to two of them.

name: invoke_six_routine_sequence
description: Invokes a fixed sequence of six shared routines in order, passing a constant zero to two of them.

name: service_per_slot_countdowns
description: For the record selected by its argument, decrements several countdown bytes and calls the shared routine with a per-slot value when each countdown is non-zero, adjusting the argument when a slot holds minus one.

name: service_countdowns_for_index
description: Handles the same countdown fields as its sibling for the index in the data register, decrementing counters and calling the shared routine, and for a pending byte also passes the index as an argument.

name: service_pending_slot_timers
description: Decrements two countdown bytes for the index in the data register and, when a pending flag byte in the table is set, passes the index to the shared routine and clears that flag.

name: run_timed_effect_sequence
description: Decrements a countdown field for the record selected by the parameter and, while it is non-zero, runs a fixed sequence of calls to the shared routine using the constants three and one.

name: emit_record_when_flagged
description: Calls a lookup routine and, when it returns non-zero, checks a per-record flag and passes that record's values and a fixed constant to the shared output routine.

name: dispatch_flagged_table_entry
description: When the shared index is zero, nine or twelve and a flag byte in the table equals four, calls the shared routine with a fixed value and then with an element of a small array chosen by bits of a second table byte.

name: dispatch_flagged_pointer_entry
description: When the byte at the pointer argument equals four, calls the shared routine with a fixed value and then with an element of a small array chosen by bits of a second table byte.

name: select_array_item_by_field
description: Shifts a table field right by two, reduces it to a value from zero to seven and passes the matching element of a shared array to the shared routine.

name: pick_array_item_from_value
description: Shifts the data register value right by two, reduces it to a value from zero to seven and passes the matching element of a shared array to the shared routine.

name: pass_array_item_low_bits
description: Masks the data register value to its low three bits and passes the matching byte from a shared table of character-like codes to the shared routine.

name: dispatch_per_index_parameters
description: Switches on the shared index and, per case, calls the shared routine with a parameter block of fixed values or values read from per-index tables, with some cases making a second call.

name: dispatch_per_pointer_parameters
description: Switches on the byte at the pointer argument and calls the shared routine with a parameter block built from per-index tables, mirroring a sibling routine that switches on the shared index.

name: set_flags_and_emit_entry
description: Sets two bits in a control byte, clears several bit masks in a status byte, and when the shared index is below four passes a table-selected value to the shared routine.

name: return_without_action
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it is an empty stub with no effect.

name: return_without_effect
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it is an empty stub with no effect.

name: emit_table_entry_for_pointer
description: Reads a table value for the byte at the pointer argument and, when non-zero, passes it with fixed arguments to the shared routine, with two specific indices also triggering a second fixed call.

name: emit_pointer_entry_pair
description: Passes a table-selected value for the pointer's byte and the shared index to the shared routine, a second value when a flag is set, and a fixed value pair for two specific indices.

name: dispatch_indexed_callbacks_range
description: Returns for indices below two, passes an array element from a shared table for indices two and eleven, calls a fixed routine for indices four and sixteen, and passes two fixed values for index nineteen or thirty when the index is at most eight.

name: emit_next_index_when_thirty
description: When the register value equals thirty and the byte at the pointer is below nine, calls the shared routine with that byte incremented by one and a fixed offset.

name: pass_lookup_array_element
description: Computes an index from the byte at the pointer through a table lookup and passes the matching element of a shared array to the shared routine.

name: emit_incremented_pointer_byte
description: When the byte at the pointer is below nine, calls the shared routine with that byte incremented by one and a fixed offset from the shared index.

name: pass_indexed_byte_value
description: Reads a byte at the pointer offset by the data register value and passes it to the shared routine as a single argument.

name: emit_indexed_byte_request
description: Selects a per-index byte from a table and passes it to the shared routine, repeating the call when the parameter is non-zero and the result is non-zero, with index eight adding a closing call of zero values.

name: emit_conditional_request_pair
description: Passes an index-selected byte to the shared routine, repeats the call when a data-register flag is set and the result is non-zero, then sends a closing call with zero values.

name: emit_closing_request_when_eight
description: Calls the shared routine and, when its result and a second flag are non-zero, calls it again; for index eight it finishes with a closing call of zero values.

name: emit_array_item_for_eleven
description: When the shared index equals eleven, looks up an array element and passes it to the shared routine twice, and otherwise returns the parameter unchanged.

name: emit_array_item_twice
description: Looks up an array element for the shared index from a short byte table and passes it to the shared routine, then calls the shared routine again with the same element and zero values.

name: emit_selected_value_request
description: Chooses a value for the shared index using a few special-case rules that adjust the position, and passes it with fixed values to the shared routine.

name: emit_pointer_selected_request
description: Selects a value for the pointer's byte, using a special value for one index and a table lookup for another, and passes it with fixed arguments to the shared routine.

name: emit_lookup_offset_request
description: Looks up an array element through a lookup routine and passes it to the shared routine with an offset taken from a per-record table at the pointer.

name: emit_flagged_default_request
description: Uses a fixed value for record code fifteen when a flag is clear and a table value otherwise, then passes it with a per-record offset to the shared routine.

name: emit_table_value_request
description: Passes a table value for the pointer's byte, offset by the data register and a per-record table value, to the shared routine with fixed arguments.

name: dispatch_special_index_requests
description: Switches on the shared index, issuing one or two calls to the shared routine with values derived from bit masks and small tables for indices two, ten, eighteen and twenty-two, and does nothing for other indices.

name: return_without_operation
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it is an empty stub with no effect.

name: dispatch_indexed_table_requests
description: Makes a fixed call for index four, dispatches indices two and eighteen to lookup-based calls, issues a pair of fixed calls for index twenty, and handles other indices through a per-index table.

name: emit_flagged_table_pair
description: Looks up a value from a small table by the low seven bits of the shared index and passes it to the shared routine, adding a second call with an offset when the top bit of the index is set.

name: emit_table_pair_by_index
description: Selects a value from a table using the low seven bits of the shared index, passes it to the shared routine, and adds a second call with an offset when the top bit is set.

name: emit_array_item_from_lookup
description: Looks up an index through a lookup routine and passes the matching element of a shared array to the shared routine.

name: emit_conditional_fixed_pair
description: When a flag is clear, passes a table value for the low seven bits of the shared index to the shared routine, and always finishes with a fixed-argument call.

name: emit_pointer_table_request
description: Reads a table value for the pointer's byte and, when non-zero, passes it with per-record offsets to the shared routine, using a different argument set for one special record code.

name: emit_same_call_either_branch
description: Calls the shared routine with the same fixed argument in both branches of a test on the pointer's byte, so the test changes nothing.

name: emit_fixed_seven_call
description: Calls the shared routine once with the constant seven and returns.

name: reset_dispatch_hook_state
description: Sets the shared dispatch hook to a stored routine and, when the state is positive and a comparison routine reports no match, calls the hook twice and marks a table cell as all ones before restoring the hook.

name: update_hook_pointer_state
description: Performs the same comparison-driven hook calls as its sibling but writes the hook through a pointer argument, then marks a table cell as all ones when the comparison reports no match.

name: emit_state_table_request
description: Returns when the state byte is non-zero; otherwise it calls or skips the shared routine depending on the index range, issues a table-driven call with an offset, and restores the hook.

name: emit_pointer_state_request
description: Mirrors its sibling but reads the table value through a pointer argument and issues the table-driven call after a pointer-byte window check, then restores the hook.

name: route_index_to_request
description: Calls a fallback routine for index zero and for indices above one other than three; otherwise checks a pointer-byte window and issues table-driven calls, then restores the hook.

name: emit_request_only_for_nineteen
description: For index nineteen, issues the table-driven call sequence after a pointer-byte check, and for any other index calls the shared fallback routine.

name: emit_table_request_with_hook
description: Checks a pointer-byte window, then issues a table-driven call and a second call with the hook restored; the referenced text is a diagnostic about a half-draw position being out of range.

name: forward_to_shared_routine
description: Calls the shared routine once and returns without passing arguments.

name: dispatch_matches_in_record_table
description: Searches a table of eighteen-byte records from last to first for entries whose tag byte equals the parameter, saves the matching indices, and passes each saved index to the shared routine after a preliminary call.

name: dispatch_matches_via_pointer_count
description: Performs the same reverse search of eighteen-byte records as its sibling, storing the match count through a pointer argument and passing each matching index to the shared routine.

name: dispatch_matches_countdown_scan
description: Walks the record table with a countdown loop, storing indices of records whose tag matches the parameter through a pointer count, then passes each stored index to the shared routine.

name: dispatch_stored_indices_loop
description: Passes each entry of a stored index list to the shared routine in order, until the count given through a pointer is reached.

name: resolve_table_state_code
description: Fills a state byte and a value byte from a per-record table or a fixed fallback, then changes state six to five and state fifteen to one when a lookup of the value exceeds one, returning the state.

name: resolve_table_state_via_pointers
description: Works like its sibling but reads and writes its state and value bytes through pointers, applying the same six-to-five and fifteen-to-one adjustments and returning the state byte.

name: reset_state_then_adjust
description: Clears a value byte, copies a state byte from the frame, applies the six-to-five and fifteen-to-one adjustments, and returns the state.

name: adjust_fifteen_state_code
description: When the state byte is fifteen and a lookup of the value exceeds one, sets the value to zero and the state to one, then returns the state.

name: update_index_from_array
description: Calls the shared routine twice with a timing value of twenty, or one when the index equals two, and then reloads the index from an array element.

name: emit_three_pair_requests
description: Makes a call with the shared index, then three requests using consecutive pairs of table bytes starting at a fixed offset, each with a constant of twenty.

name: emit_ten_entry_requests
description: Makes ten requests from a table of two-byte entries starting after a fixed offset, with the shared index chosen by whether it equals two, then closes with a fixed request.

name: emit_ten_strided_requests
description: Makes ten requests stepping through a pointer-based table by two bytes each, then closes with two fixed calls.

name: check_special_index_membership
description: Returns one when the shared index is zero, nine, twelve or twenty-six, and zero for every other index.

name: test_index_zero_or_nine
description: Returns one when the data register word is zero or nine, and zero otherwise.

name: test_index_is_twenty_six
description: Returns true only when the data register word equals twenty-six.

name: return_constant_true
description: Always returns one, ignoring its inputs.

name: emit_indexed_table_request
description: Reads a per-index code from a table; for codes seven and twelve it issues a call with an element from a second table only when the shared flag is set, codes twenty use a distinct value, and other codes pass a table-selected argument.

name: emit_pointer_indexed_request
description: Reads a value for the data register index and issues a call with a table-selected argument, using a distinct code for index twenty and a generic code otherwise, with the value taken through a pointer argument.

name: emit_table_request_from_pointer
description: Issues a call with a table-selected argument for the data register code and the value read through a pointer argument.

name: clamp_high_bit_to_five
description: If the high bit of the value is set, returns five; otherwise returns the value unchanged.

name: emit_parity_offset_request
description: Derives a flag from the lowest bit of the parameter and a position from table offsets, then issues a request whose code is fourteen or fifteen by bit parity.

name: emit_register_parity_request
description: Performs the same parity-based request as its sibling using values held in registers rather than arguments.

name: emit_constant_eight_request
description: Issues a single request to the shared routine with the constant eight.

name: emit_code_eight_request
description: Issues a single request with the constant eight, identical to its sibling routine.

name: emit_parity_position_request
description: Issues a request whose code is sixteen or seventeen by the parity of the parameter, with the position set to twenty-four when the parameter is below two and otherwise taken from an offset.

name: emit_register_position_request
description: Performs the same parity and position request as its sibling using register inputs, setting the position to twenty-four when the index is below two.

name: decode_high_bit_flagged_value
description: Returns the byte with its top bit cleared when that bit is set, or one when the remaining value exceeds ten; bytes without the top bit are returned unchanged.

name: return_empty_stub
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it is an empty stub with no effect.

name: store_record_entry_when_valid
description: When the second argument is neither zero nor 256 and the table lookup succeeds, writes six fields into a record slot selected by the shared count, increments the count and returns one; it reports overflow when the count exceeds 199.

name: store_back_table_entry
description: Stores a six-field record in a back table slot selected by the shared count, reports the BackTable overflow message when the count exceeds 199, and returns whether the lookup succeeded.

name: write_record_fields_unconditionally
description: Writes record fields through a pointer argument from register and frame inputs, derives a position from a lookup word, increments the count and returns one, with no overflow check.

name: store_second_record_entry
description: Performs the same validated record store as its sibling into a second fixed-size record block, incrementing the shared count when the lookup succeeds.

name: store_fore_table_entry
description: Stores a six-field record in a fore table slot selected by the shared count, reports the ForeTable overflow message when the count exceeds 199, and returns whether the lookup succeeded.

name: write_record_fields_direct
description: Writes record fields through a pointer argument from register and frame inputs, derives a position from a lookup word, increments the count and returns one, without an overflow check.

name: store_sixteen_byte_record
description: Fills a sixteen-byte record slot selected by the shared count with four words and a lookup result, subtracting 128 from the final byte when a table flag is set, and reports overflow when the count exceeds 49.

name: store_mid_table_record_entry
description: Fills a sixteen-byte mid table record with four words and a lookup result, reports the MidTable overflow message past 49 records, and returns one only when both lookups succeed.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero unconditionally, with no other effect.

name: store_record_when_lookup_found
description: Looks up an entry for the shared index and the second argument, and when found writes a fixed-layout record through the pointer argument, adjusts a frame value by 128 when a table flag is set, increments the count and returns one.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns zero unconditionally, with no other effect.

name: store_record_when_lookup_matches
description: Performs the same lookup-driven record store as its sibling, writing the fixed-layout record through a pointer and returning one on success or zero when the lookup fails.

name: write_record_with_flag_adjust
description: Writes a record through a pointer from a lookup word and register inputs, adds 128 to a frame value when a table flag is set, increments the count and returns one without an overflow check.

name: forward_six_arguments
description: Forwards its six arguments unchanged to the shared routine and returns.

name: store_wipe_table_entry
description: Writes an eight-byte entry into a wipe table slot selected by the shared count, reports the WipeTable overflow message when the count exceeds 299, and increments the count.

name: store_object_table_entry
description: Writes an eighteen-byte object table record selected by the shared count, sets a fixed block of default fields and a flag bit from the argument, and reports the ObjTable overflow message past 49 records.

name: fill_object_table_entry
description: Fills an eighteen-byte object table record selected by the shared count, deriving its fields from the argument and two lookup results, and reports the ObjTable overflow message past 49 records.

name: reset_value_after_scaling
description: Computes a clamped, quarter-scaled value from the shared value and then overwrites the shared value with zero.

name: reset_value_to_zero
description: Loads the shared value with forty-eight, subtracts forty-eight, and leaves the shared value at zero.

name: zero_value_from_register
description: Computes a quarter of the data register value plus one, subtracts it from itself, and always leaves the shared value at zero.

name: emit_stepped_index_requests
description: Issues one of two request sets depending on a comparison, then steps a value down in eights and emits a request for each step within a bounded range.

name: emit_stepped_pointer_requests
description: Performs the same request sequence as its sibling using a value read through a pointer argument, stepping a range down in eights and emitting a request for each step.

name: emit_downward_stepped_requests
description: Emits a request for each value stepped down by eight from the given position within a bounded range, then emits one final request for the leftover position.

name: emit_downward_steps_until_bound
description: Steps a position down by eight while it stays above a bound, calling the shared routine for each step, and then emits one final request for the leftover position.

name: emit_eight_step_requests_bounded
description: Steps a position down by eight while a bound check passes, calling the shared routine for each step, then emits one final request for the leftover position when it lies within range.

name: emit_step_requests_with_guard
description: Steps a position down by eight under a combined bound and guard check, and emits one final request for the leftover position when it lies within range.

name: emit_fixed_then_stepped_requests
description: Emits a fixed-code request, then a request for each value stepped down by eight within a bounded range, using a second fixed code for the steps.

name: emit_stepped_code_requests
description: Emits a request with code one hundred fifty-two for each value stepped down by eight within a bounded range.

name: emit_steps_while_above_bound
description: Walks a position down by eight and calls the shared routine on each step while the position stays above a table value and a second bound.

name: emit_steps_until_table_limit
description: Walks a position down by eight and calls the shared routine on each step while the position stays above a table value, stopping at zero or at a second bound.

name: emit_steps_with_lookahead
description: Calls the shared routine at each position stepped down by eight, stopping when the next position falls below zero, reaches a bound, or passes a table value check.

name: emit_record_index_sweeps
description: For each record up to a count held in a shared byte, calls the shared routine with the record index, copies two table bytes into the shared value, then calls the routine for each index from zero to twenty-nine.

name: emit_record_sweeps_to_limit
description: Performs the same record sweep as its sibling with the loop bound read through a pointer argument, calling the shared routine for each index from zero to twenty-nine per record.

name: set_neighbour_flags_for_cell
description: Updates a cell's flag byte from its code, and for code twenty sets low flag bits when the left and right neighbours also hold code twenty, wrapping to the adjacent row at each ten-column row end.

name: update_cell_flag_by_code
description: Sets or clears a cell's flag byte based on its code, using two fixed flag values for codes four and five and a conditional value for code ten.

name: set_neighbour_flags_via_pointer
description: Performs the same neighbour check as its sibling for code twenty, reading the row data through a pointer and setting low flag bits when adjacent cells match.

name: set_flag_from_unit_value
description: Sets the byte to minus sixty-eight when it equals one, and to zero otherwise.

name: clear_byte_at_pointer
description: Writes zero to the byte at the pointer argument.

name: zero_pointed_byte
description: Writes zero to the byte at the pointer argument, identical to its sibling routine.

name: shift_flag_and_mark_match
description: Shifts the byte left by five bits, then sets it to minus sixty-four when a special flag and two table comparisons match the argument.

name: set_neighbour_flags_shifted
description: Shifts the flag byte left by seven, then sets low bits for each side whose adjacent cell holds code twenty, with the left and right neighbours wrapping to the adjacent row at row ends.

name: set_neighbour_flags_pair
description: Sets bits one, two or three in a flag byte according to whether the left and right neighbour cells hold code twenty, using a per-row lookup for cells at each row end.

name: set_right_neighbour_flags
description: Sets flag bits from a left-neighbour check and a right-neighbour check with the left check inverted, so the flag reflects where code twenty is absent on one side.

name: set_neighbour_flags_from_row
description: Sets flag bits from left and right neighbour checks, reading the adjacent row for the right check at row ends, and combines the two results into one, two or three.

name: set_right_neighbour_flag_bits
description: Sets flag bits from a precomputed side flag and a right-neighbour test for code twenty, setting bit one, bit two, or both.

name: set_neighbour_bits_from_flags
description: Sets bit one in a flag byte when the second flag is non-zero and the first is zero, or bit two when the first flag is non-zero.

name: set_bit_when_flag_set
description: Sets bit one in a flag byte when the supplied flag is non-zero.

name: return_no_operation
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it is an empty stub with no effect.

name: run_indexed_call_schedule
description: Runs a fixed schedule of shared-routine calls: an initial pair, a three-pass outer loop with ten inner calls per pass, a closing pair, and a final ten-call loop, ending with a call that passes minus one.

name: run_pointer_call_schedule
description: Runs the same schedule shape as its sibling, using values read through pointer arguments for the inner calls, and ends with a call that passes minus one.

name: emit_request_with_parameter
description: Calls the shared routine with a zero, the shared value twice, the parameter, the constant four and a zero.

name: iterate_counted_entries
description: Looks up a count from a shared array by the parameter, then calls the shared routine for each index below that count, passing only the index for group three and both values for other groups.

name: emit_range_requests_by_flag
description: Walks a counter up to a limit, calling the shared routine with the counter when a flag is set and with no argument when it is clear.

name: emit_flagged_range_requests
description: Calls the shared routine with each counter value up to a limit while a flag is set, repeating a fixed call between passes.

name: emit_indices_matching_tag
description: Scans the shared record table up to its count and calls the shared routine with each record index whose tag byte equals the parameter.

name: emit_matching_tag_indices_range
description: Scans records from a start index to a limit in eight-byte steps, calling the shared routine with each index whose tag equals the register value.

name: emit_record_request_by_group
description: Selects one of two record tables by the group argument for groups zero and one, and passes the entry at the given index, with its fields and a looked-up value, to the shared routine.

name: emit_record_request_for_index
description: Passes the record at a table position computed from the shared index to the shared routine as a set of fields and a looked-up value.

name: emit_record_request_with_pair
description: Reads a sixteen-byte record selected by the argument and passes its fields to the shared routine, with a preparatory call and a follow-up call when a per-slot flag is set.

name: emit_rectangle_request_checked
description: Builds four coordinates from an eight-byte record, runs a check routine on them, and when it passes calls the shared routine with a fixed code and the record's extra byte.

name: emit_adjusted_rectangle_request
description: Computes adjusted dimensions from a looked-up entry and argument bits, mirrors offsets when the high bit of the fifth argument is set, and passes the results to the shared routine with one of several fixed codes.

name: emit_adjusted_rectangle_via_registers
description: Performs the same adjusted request as its sibling, reading the entry and mode from the frame and data registers and calling the shared routine through a code pointer.

name: emit_adjusted_request_from_offset
description: Performs a shortened variant of the adjusted request, deriving its position from half of the input value and calling the shared routine through a code pointer.

name: emit_adjusted_request_halved
description: Issues the adjusted request through a code pointer with the position taken from half of the input value, using the fixed codes for the default and special modes.

name: set_flag_bits_then_call
description: ORs bit masks into one byte at a computed offset and into three words of a record, then ORs another word and calls the shared routine through a code pointer.

name: emit_mode_request_with_check
description: Passes frame fields and the constants eight, four and one to a code pointer after a range check; the referenced messages report a bad colour value or drawing mode.

name: emit_banded_request_sequence
description: Emits a fixed-code request, an optional second request, a loop of request code thirty-three across a range in steps of four, and a closing request with code thirty-four.

name: emit_closing_code_request
description: Emits a request with code thirty-four using a value read through a pointer and an offset from the shared index.

name: set_record_base_pointer
description: Stores the argument as the shared index and, when it is non-zero, sets the shared base to the record base for that index using a stride of thirty bytes.

name: set_record_base_from_register
description: Sets the shared base to the record base for the index in the data register, using a stride of thirty bytes.

name: emit_fixed_six_call_sequence
description: Makes four argument-less calls to the shared routine followed by two calls passing zero.

name: sort_index_list_by_comparison
description: Bubble-sorts a short index list in place, using the shared comparison routine on adjacent pairs and swapping them until a pass makes no swap.

name: sort_index_list_in_passes
description: Performs an in-place pairwise sort of a short index list in repeated passes using the shared comparison routine, restarting from the beginning until a pass makes no swap.

name: compare_records_by_order_key
description: Compares two indexed records, returning true when the first is in state one and false when the second is, otherwise ordering by a position field and using a second key when both states are minus 128.

name: compare_record_position_pair
description: Returns whether one indexed record is ordered before another by position, returning false when the first record has state one and comparing a secondary position when both states are minus 128.

name: compare_record_position_secondary
description: Returns true when the first of two records has a smaller position field than the second, taking the minus-128 state case into account.

name: compare_record_positions_plain
description: Returns true when the position field of the first indexed record is less than that of the second.

name: emit_mode_dispatch_requests
description: Switches on the value returned by a lookup and makes one or more shared-routine requests with values derived from the shared index, with several cases sharing one request path and case 128 issuing three requests.

name: emit_three_requests_for_code
description: When the input equals one hundred twenty-eight and a table byte is not 255, issues three requests using that byte with offsets derived from the shared index.

name: emit_parity_checked_request
description: Unless a table byte is 255, emits a request whose argument depends on the parity of the shared index: an even index issues a three-step request set and an odd index a single request.

name: emit_parity_request_from_input
description: Emits a set of requests when the input is even and a single request otherwise, using a table byte offset by one.

name: emit_offset_request_sixteen
description: Emits a single request with code sixteen, using a table byte offset by one as its second argument.

name: emit_even_index_request_set
description: For the even branch, emits an optional request of code forty-one when the index equals two, then a standard request set built from a table byte offset by one.

name: emit_three_requests_for_entry
description: Sets the shared index to 255 and, when the byte at the pointer is not 255, issues three requests using that byte with fixed offsets.

name: emit_incremented_table_request
description: Passes the shared index and a table byte incremented by one to the shared routine, together with the shared index repeated three times.

name: load_record_fields_to_shared
description: Copies several fields of an eighteen-byte record selected by the argument into the shared value and returns that record's flag byte.

name: emit_fixed_five_call_sequence
description: Makes five argument-less calls to the shared routine in sequence.

name: emit_conditional_triple_calls
description: When the shared value is non-zero and matches its short form, makes a call, a second call if the value is negative, and a third call.

name: emit_triple_calls_alt
description: Follows the same pattern as its sibling, but applies when the shared value is not eighty-six and matches its short form.

name: emit_nine_call_sequence
description: Makes nine argument-less calls to the shared routine, then one call passing zero.

name: emit_nine_calls_then_mode
description: Makes nine argument-less calls, then calls the shared routine with one or two depending on the shared value, changing the value to one hundred thirty-seven in one special case.

name: emit_request_code_two
description: Calls the shared routine with the argument two.

name: store_value_and_mark_slot
description: Stores the shared value in a field of an eighteen-byte record selected by the argument and sets a flag byte in a table at the value's position when that value is below thirty.

name: derive_packed_byte_pair
description: Calls two routines, then derives a shared value from a stored word by shifting, adding three and scaling through a lookup, and combines it with a stored byte into packed low and high byte results.

name: set_two_fixed_constants
description: Sets the shared value to sixty and then to seven hundred nineteen, leaving that final constant.

name: split_value_into_eighths
description: Splits a signed value into a quotient by eight and a remainder from zero to seven, storing both through two output pointers and mirroring the remainder for negative inputs.

name: split_eighths_with_mirrored_remainder
description: Stores the quotient of the data register value by eight into one output and seven minus the remainder into another, with sign-aware remainder computation.

name: store_value_minus_low_bits
description: Stores the register byte minus its low three bits into the output byte.

name: store_eighths_quotient_and_remainder
description: Writes the signed value divided by eight and its remainder from zero to seven to two output bytes, with negative inputs handled by mirrored arithmetic.

name: store_eighths_quotient_remainder
description: Stores the data register value divided by eight into one output and its low three bits, sign-adjusted for negative values, into another.

name: store_low_three_bits
description: Stores the low three bits of the data register byte to the output byte.

name: scale_value_by_ratio
description: Returns the argument multiplied by three hundred twenty and divided by two hundred eighty, truncated to a signed word.

name: emit_zero_offset_request
description: Calls the shared routine with the shared value's location, zero and the constant twenty.

name: emit_request_pair_with_result
description: Issues a zero-argument call and records its result, passes the shared value with the argument and the constants four, three and eight, then issues a final call with the recorded result.
